policy: Pinned approved snapshots; no browser feedback, modification-time selection or game-file writes. Source IDs identify retained variants.

armory.evidence: Approved eight batches, later lore variants and magical shimmer; individual selected pixels are pinned below. Historical pending fields are superseded only by the explicit later approvals.

interiors-r4.evidence: All 14 views approved: “Ok these all look good”. Includes final serpentine guard and restored Markus table height.

shield-545.evidence: Approved native-size ground revision and retained paperdoll design, converted and installed.

shield-663.evidence: Approved curved-heater-derived shield with valorite rim only; supersedes older kite shield.

inn.evidence: “The inn is good. synchronize the approved previews”.

dell.evidence: “great this is what we want install it”; approved lever under the leather armor above the corner desk.

homes.evidence: “it is looking very good now. I think now we need sleeping npcs”, following the wider beds, lowered easels, lighter floor and stock-stair home revision. The selected room captures are approved previews, not claims of final walkability.

rake.evidence: Existing approved stock-rake gallery; retained unchanged.

confirmed-2026-11-16.evidence: User confirmed the five withheld equipment entries and revised Fellowship column bottoms: “Those mentioned are all actually approved. so continue with it”. Applies to the existing revisions only; the new chainmail plate-arm proposal is separate.

chain-plate-2026-11-16.evidence: chain + armlets look good. it is approved. Go on and implement this in the game and the paperdoll previews in the atlas. then push it to the github site.

precedence: Approved shield replacements and final guard contour
